name: ai-ask
title: AI
description: Ask a question from the root search, or hold a conversation, through the local pxy proxy
author: saiful

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.description: Answer the typed question with a model, streamed into a detail view

commands.name: chat
commands.title: AI Chat
commands.description: Hold a conversation with a model, with follow-ups and saved history

commands.name: imagine
commands.title: Imagine
commands.description: Generate an image from a description through pxy, kept in a grid with everything generated before

commands.name: video
commands.title: Video
commands.description: Render a short video from a description through pxy; takes minutes, kept in a list with earlier renders

preferences.name: webTools
preferences.title: Tools
preferences.label: Web search and page fetching in AI Chat
preferences.description: Lets the chat model call web_search and fetch_url, served by pxy's search and fetch providers. Ask AI (the Tab command) never uses tools.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: A pxy group, not a single model: each is a failover chain tried in order. General starts at ollama.com's hosted nemotron (a cloud API with a key, not a local daemon) and falls over to Cloudflare.
